name: Harumi Rimu
source:
A four-star Solfina working for NS. Unusually for a Solfina, she has a delicate air that makes people want to protect her, and she is popular as "the nation's little sister". In reality she is two-faced and very ambitious. She shows little enthusiasm for combat training and puts all her effort into streaming, so her fighting skills are not very good.

She used to act as if she looked up to Suina when Suina was the Prime Star, and to Suina she was a cute junior and the only person at the company she could call a friend. After Suina's downfall, Rimu was chosen as the new Prime Star.

[From DLsite, translated]
